question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
sql:
-- Final query with integer casting
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.over_id,
        bbb.innings_no,
        bbb.bowler,
        CAST(SUM(bs.runs_scored) + SUM(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS BIGINT) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er 
        ON bbb.match_id = er.match_id AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.match_id, bbb.over_id, bbb.innings_no, bbb.bowler
),
match_max AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(runs_conceded) as max_runs_in_match
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_over_runs AS (
    SELECT om.match_id, om.over_id, om.innings_no, om.bowler, om.runs_conceded, mm.max_runs_in_match
    FROM over_runs om
    JOIN match_max mm ON om.match_id = mm.match_id
    WHERE om.runs_conceded = mm.max_runs_in_match
),
bowler_best AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        match_id,
        runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY runs_conceded DESC) as rn
    FROM max_over_runs
)
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, bb.match_id, bb.runs_conceded
FROM bowler_best bb
JOIN player p ON bb.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bb.rn = 1
ORDER BY bb.runs_conceded DESC
LIMIT 3
